adapters.name: SureFit Hosel
adapters.description: Titleist's adjustable hosel system. Allows independent loft and lie adjustments. Same adapter works across TSR and GT generations.

adapters.name: TaylorMade Tip Sleeve
adapters.description: TaylorMade's loft sleeve system. 12 positions for loft and face angle adjustment. Compatible across recent TaylorMade drivers.

adapters.name: OptiFit Hosel
adapters.description: Callaway's OptiFit system with adjustable loft and lie. Draw setting promotes right-to-left ball flight. Works across Paradym, Ai Smoke, and Elyte families.

adapters.name: PING Trajectory Tuning
adapters.description: PING's trajectory tuning hosel with 8 positions. Adjusts loft, lie, and face angle. Requires PING wrench tool.

adapters.name: MyFly8 with SmartPad
adapters.description: Cobra's MyFly8 system with 8 adjustable loft settings. SmartPad technology keeps face square at address regardless of loft setting.

adapters.name: Quick Switch Hosel
adapters.description: Mizuno's Quick Switch adjustable hosel. 4 loft positions with 2 lie settings each for 8 total configurations.

adapters.name: Quick Tune System (QTS)
adapters.description: Srixon's Quick Tune System for loft and lie adjustment. 12 positions total. Compatible with Srixon/Cleveland drivers.

compatibility_notes.universal_tip: All modern driver shafts use .335" tip diameter. Any shaft will physically fit any adapter.
compatibility_notes.adapter_requirement: When buying an aftermarket shaft, you need an adapter that matches your head's brand/system.
compatibility_notes.adapter_cost: Aftermarket adapters typically cost $15-40. OEM adapters may cost more.
compatibility_notes.torque_matters: Shaft tip installation requires proper torque (typically 30-40 in-lbs). Over-tightening can damage threads.
compatibility_notes.epoxy_tip: Adapters are epoxied to the shaft. Changing heads is easy; changing adapters requires re-tipping.
